description: Hugging Face Hub API — list the files in a model repository at a given revision (branch, tag or commit; main by default) and optional subdirectory path. Returns each entry's path, type, byte size and blob SHA, including LFS details for weight shards. Answers which weight, config and tokenizer files ship in a Hugging Face model repo and how large they are.
name: list_model_files

outputSchema.description: List of files in a model repository

title: List Model Files
